customManagers.description: Update Renovate-annotated tool pins in the justfile

packageRules.description: OpenTelemetry: update core (v1.x) and the 0.x log modules together in ONE PR and never automerge - a core bump without the log modules (or vice-versa) breaks the build. A bump here also needs the third_party forks re-vendored by hand; see third_party/README.md.

go-licenses stays on v1: v2+ changes the module path to /v2 and reworks the `report --template` CLI. Renovate cannot read the justfile comment saying so, and a v2.0.1 bump broke CI on 2026-08-29 because the install path still resolved v1's module.
